component.name: Open Merchant
component.summary: Decide whether a product is worth pursuing, and keep the evidence

description.p: Open Merchant is a local-first desktop workbench for deciding whether a product opportunity is commercially worth pursuing, and for keeping the evidence behind that decision.

Every decision gets its own folder on your own disk. Objective, evidence, competitor listings, cost assumptions, and an evidence-linked opportunity report — instead of scattered tabs and a spreadsheet you will not find again. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is locked in, and nothing happens without you pressing the button.

ul.li: Competitor listings, unit economics, and a report, in exact decimal arithmetic
Market snapshots: a timestamped price history you can check later
A margin monitor and a decision journal that keep watching after you close the app
A portfolio across every project, worst margin first
Restate a project in another currency at a rate you enter yourself
CSV import with row-by-row reasons for anything rejected, CSV export, single-file backups
Six optional assistants that draft, and write nothing until you accept it
A read-only MCP server so an assistant can read the record, never write it

description.p: The arithmetic is done in tested application code using arbitrary-precision decimals — never by a language model, never by binary floating point. Language models may draft; they may not calculate, and they may not write to your project without your acceptance.

ul.li: Read-only MCP server, shipped inside the app and on npm
Plugin surface: capability-declared, loaded as data, never as code
MCP connector client, returning drafts rather than data
The Draft Desk: one visible gate for every assistant
Project currency restatement in exact decimals

description.p: 1.0 promises one thing: that a version 2 project folder keeps opening. It is plain JSON and JSONL, and you can read it without us.
